mechanism: Human: overwrite only the movement-cost Pathfinding input withExpert3, canonical terrain discount75. AI: once at owning turn OnEveryDay, add400 to remaining points HE:W and current daily maximum HE:G, after ordinary movement regeneration. No AI terrain bypass; no human daily400.
nativeState: ONE_DAY ERA_SOURCE_ARTIFACT_STATE [1,260,day,initialBoatMode] on the hero prevents duplicate new-day receipt on resume. A separate post-multiplier MOVEMENT400 maximum applies only to the current initial land/sea layer; boarding/disembarking removes that maximum, keeps the day receipt and the native scaled/consumed remaining points.
scope: Source OW:A reads the selected human hero. The native TurnInfo argument is the actual hero being calculated; ordinary mobile path requests use that selected hero, while unrelated native prediction queries do not borrow another hero equipment.
verificationLimits: The AI day receipt and current-layer maximum were observed in a real native save as two encoded [1,260,day,layer] vectors. A fresh-context human save/load verifies the ordinary movement/equipment pipeline; the AI receipt itself was not directly replayed after load.
